verdict_text:
YES

The script verifies key-set equality across all three checkpoints and bit-exact equality of every non-MLP tensor before any writing (step 1), selects exactly the 64 MLP tensors by a `fullmatch` regex over the four names per layer, and computes each task vector against the untouched `base` dict — `out = dict(base)` is a fresh mapping, so no merged value ever feeds back into a later subtraction (step 2, ordering hazard avoided). Arithmetic is done in float32 via `.float()` and cast back to the base dtype, all other tensors are carried over from the base unchanged with unchanged names (steps 2–3), and the output goes to `out/T4/model.safetensors` by default (step 4). The three required checks are all present and failing: the shared-tensor asserts, `assert merged == 64`, and `assert len(out) == 244`. The duplicate `import json` and the unused capture group in the regex are cosmetic and change nothing.
